# Reproducible Growth Case Foundation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build one versioned, validated case-study manifest and three high-quality project-authored before/after cases generated by the current VideoScope code.

**Architecture:** A checked-in JSON manifest is the single source of truth. TypeScript validates it for the public site, Node scripts generate/audit only declared public media, and a Python orchestrator generates deterministic inputs then runs the real Rescue and Publish Ready pipelines with exact confirmation and verification.

**Tech Stack:** TypeScript, JSON, Node.js `execFile`, Python 3.11+, FFmpeg/ffprobe, existing VideoScope Rescue/Resolve pipelines, Vitest, pytest.

## Global Constraints

- Preserve source files byte-for-byte and publish only new outputs.
- Use the exact provenance enum `project-authored | user-authorized | synthetic-regression`.
- The initial three public cases must all be `project-authored` and generated by the current checkout.
- Store no usernames, personal absolute paths, API keys, prompts, user video, or private preview paths in public manifests.
- Compare identical source time ranges and record the range in seconds in the manifest.
- A case with `needs_review`, `partial`, or failed verification cannot have `featured: true`.
- External commands use argument arrays with `shell=False` in Python or `execFile` in Node.
- Generated public video targets are H.264/AAC MP4, at most 1280×720, at most 30 fps, and at most 25 seconds per file.
- The public case-media directory is an exact manifest allowlist; no undeclared file is deployed.
- Base tests mock process execution and never download media or models.

- [ ] **Step 3: Add the exact type and validator surface**

```ts
import rawManifest from "./case-studies.json";

export type CaseProvenance = "project-authored" | "user-authorized" | "synthetic-regression";
export type LocalizedCaseText = Readonly<{ en: string; "zh-CN": string }>;
export type PublicCaseStatus = "completed" | "needs_review" | "partial" | "failed";
export type PublicVerificationStatus = "passed" | "needs_review" | "failed";

export interface CaseAction {
  readonly workflow: "video-rescue" | "publish-ready";
  readonly actionId: string;
  readonly version: string;
  readonly kind: string;
  readonly description: LocalizedCaseText;
  readonly parameters: Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>>;
}

export interface CaseVerificationCheck {
  readonly checkId: string;
  readonly status: PublicVerificationStatus;
  readonly summary: LocalizedCaseText;
  readonly measured: Readonly<Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>>;
}

export interface CaseStudy {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly slug: string;
  readonly featured: boolean;
  readonly provenance: CaseProvenance;
  readonly authorizationSummary: LocalizedCaseText;
  readonly title: LocalizedCaseText;
  readonly summary: LocalizedCaseText;
  readonly observableSymptom: LocalizedCaseText;
  readonly actions: readonly CaseAction[];
  readonly unresolved: readonly LocalizedCaseText[];
  readonly limitations: readonly LocalizedCaseText[];
  readonly comparison: Readonly<{ startSeconds: number; endSeconds: number }>;
  readonly media: Readonly<{ durationSeconds: number; width: number; height: number; frameRate: number }>;
  readonly versions: Readonly<{ videoscope: string; ffmpeg: string; platform: string; configuration: string }>;
  readonly verification: Readonly<{ status: PublicCaseStatus; checks: readonly CaseVerificationCheck[] }>;
  readonly assets: Readonly<{ beforeVideo: string; afterVideo: string; poster: string; publicReport: string }>;
  readonly sha256: Readonly<{ beforeVideo: string; afterVideo: string; poster: string; publicReport: string }>;
  readonly reproduction: readonly string[];
}

export interface CaseStudyManifest {
  readonly schemaVersion: 1;
  readonly generatedBy: string;
  readonly cases: readonly CaseStudy[];
}

export const caseStudyManifest = validateCaseStudyManifest(rawManifest);
export const featuredCaseStudies = caseStudyManifest.cases.filter(
  (item) => item.featured && item.verification.status === "completed",
);
export function findCaseStudy(slug: string): CaseStudy | undefined {
  return caseStudyManifest.cases.find((item) => item.slug === slug);
}
```

The validator must reject duplicate IDs/slugs, unsafe paths, invalid hashes, unknown keys, empty bilingual copy, non-positive ranges, a range past the media duration, `featured` non-completed cases, and `synthetic-regression` records whose copy contains “real user”/“真实用户”.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement bounded external-command execution**

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CommandResult:
    returncode: int
    stderr: str


def run_command(argv: Sequence[str], *, timeout_seconds: float) -> CommandResult:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        list(argv),
        capture_output=True,
        check=False,
        shell=False,
        text=True,
        timeout=timeout_seconds,
    )
    return CommandResult(
        completed.returncode, sanitize_diagnostic(completed.stderr[-4000:])
    )
```

All destinations must be resolved below a newly created staging directory; publication is an atomic rename only after every output is verified.

- [ ] **Step 5: Execute the real workflows with exact confirmation**

```python
preparation = rescue.prepare(source_path)
confirmation = RescueConfirmation(
    plan_digest=preparation.plan.plan_digest,
    publish_faithful=True,
    publish_improved=include_improved,
    accepted_action_ids=tuple(
        action.id for action in preparation.plan.actions if action.requires_confirmation
    ),
    accepted_trim_damage_ids=(),
)
confirmed = rescue.confirm(preparation, confirmation)
result = rescue.execute(confirmed, confirmation)
if result.status is not RescueStatus.COMPLETED:
    raise CaseGenerationError(f"Case {slug} was not completed")
```

Feed the chosen verified Rescue artifact into `PublishReadyPipeline` for the relevant cases. Confirm only the exact returned `plan_digest`. Reject any case whose verification status is not `passed`/`completed`.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement exact case verification**

```js
export async function verifyCaseMedia({ manifest, directory, runner }) {
  validateCaseManifest(manifest);
  const declared = declaredCaseFiles(manifest);
  await assertExactFileAllowlist(directory, declared);
  for (const item of manifest.cases) {
    await verifyHashBindings(item, directory);
    await verifySameRangeMedia(item, directory, runner);
    await verifyPublicReport(item, directory);
  }
  return { caseCount: manifest.cases.length, fileCount: declared.size };
}
```

ffprobe checks must require H.264, yuv420p, at most 1280×720, at most 30 fps, duration matching the declared comparison within one frame, and a decodable first and last frame.
